items.title: Six killed, 40 injured as passenger train derails in Pakistan

items.title: India operationalises resident mission in Costa Rica

items.title: Pope Leo XIV recovering after lung cancer operation
items.description: Pope Leo XIV spent a calm night and was to begin post-surgery recovery Wednesday, a day after having a cancerous tumour removed from his lung. Part of the pope's right lung was removed in the operation and the leader of the world's 1.4 billion Catholics is awaiting the results of tests to determine if the cancer has spread. FRANCE 24's Seema Gupta reports from Rome, Italy.

items.title: Is Zelensky right to say data centre strikes have taken down Russian bots?

items.title: Ondo govt orders river fumigation, emergency water supply in Igbokoda over military aircraft crash
